purpose: Bounded visual QA of all 120 downloaded public ModVerse vehicle thumbnails. Source assets/indexes/catalogs unchanged.
method: Six readable source-derived contact sheets inspected visually. Originals for images 17, 58 and 64 inspected separately. All120 exact source SHA256 values rechecked after review.

policy.sourceArtwork: Reference artwork and vehicle collages are labelled separately from direct game images.

policy.scope: These are exactly the120 public vehicle thumbnails in the captured acquisition index. No1962outfitgeneratedcovers or869publisher-source-imageoutfits were pixel-reviewed here.
